{{Quote|Qui-Gon Jinn and Adi Gallia, we are here to escort you to the High Court. You have been found guilty of mind control. Come quietly or you will be shot.|[[Enforcement Guide]]|<ref name="TFFT">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref>}}
The '''High Court''' was the judiciary body on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. The High Court, run by [[Judgment Guide]]s wearing red tunics, met in the coliseum of the [[Gathering Circle]] at the center of the city of Kegan. Although Kegan was a mostly peaceful society, the [[Enforcement Guide]]s and [[Security Guide]]s were willing to use force if necessary to keep peace among the [[Keganite]]s.<ref name="TFFT" />

==History==
In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] were brought before the High Court on charges of mind control. Jinn had used a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on a security guard in order to gain access to and disable the [[central instruction processor]] controlling [[autohopper]]s that monitored the citizens of Kegan. The two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] were found guilty of the crime, and the court sentenced them to deportation from the planet.<ref name="TFFT" />
